matter_name: Cascade Retail Holdings - Universal Shelf Registration Statement (Form S-3)
matter_description: Calderwood & Harkness LLP serves as issuer's counsel to Cascade Retail Holdings Inc. in preparing and filing a new $3.0 billion universal shelf registration statement on Form S-3 with the SEC (as a well-known seasoned issuer, for automatic effectiveness), to replace the Company's expiring $2.5 billion shelf, including preliminary diligence, drafting the base prospectus and prospectus-supplement templates, board authorization, and coordination with underwriters and auditors through effectiveness.
matter_type: capital markets / securities offering (shelf registration, issuer's counsel)

client.name: Cascade Retail Holdings Inc.
client.entity_type: Delaware corporation, publicly traded on Nasdaq Global Select Market (ticker: CRHI), SEC CIK 0001287450

contacts.name: Diane Kowalski
contacts.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary

contacts.name: Marcus Cheng
contacts.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer

contacts.name: Anya Petrova
contacts.title: Vice President, Deputy General Counsel - Securities & Corporate Governance

Granville & Hooper LLP
other_parties.role: Company's independent registered public accounting firm (auditor)

key_deadlines.what: Delivery of diligence request list to CRH
First draft of Form S-3 registration statement (base prospectus)
First drafts of prospectus supplements (equity ATM, debt)
Board of Directors meeting to approve shelf filing resolutions (mid-May 2026, exact date TBD)
Target SEC filing date and automatic effectiveness of new registration statement (as WKSI)
Expiration of prior shelf registration statement (File No. 333-248710)

status.basis: No closing or effectiveness-confirmation documents among sources. Engagement letter (2026-04-09) and kick-off call materials (2026-04-14) show the engagement mid-stream toward a target SEC filing/effectiveness date of May 26, 2026; the engagement's scope explicitly runs 'through and including the effectiveness of the Registration Statement,' which is not yet confirmed as achieved in the sources reviewed.

deal_or_case.transaction_value: $3,000,000,000 aggregate offering amount (new universal shelf); prior shelf was $2,500,000,000 with $1,225,000,000 remaining capacity
filing_numbers: Prior shelf: SEC File No. 333-248710 (filed 2023-06-12, effective 2023-06-28, expiring 2026-06-28)

significant_events.what: Prior shelf registration statement (File No. 333-248710) filed with SEC
Prior shelf declared effective ($2,500,000,000 aggregate offering amount)
Underwritten common stock offering under prior shelf; ~$800,000,000 gross proceeds (Redmond Zanthor & Co. lead book-runner)
Underwritten offering of $475,000,000 5.125% Senior Notes due 2034 under prior shelf (Redmond Zanthor and Pinnacle Bancorp Securities joint book-runners)
New-matter memorandum approved; conflicts check cleared; matter 1038-00003 opened
Kick-off call held with CRH, C&H, and anticipated underwriters
Target filing date for new $3,000,000,000 shelf registration statement; automatic effectiveness as WKSI
Expiration date of prior shelf registration statement
